subject: Emotions
title: Empathic Accuracy
description: A quick, practical guide to Empathic Accuracy.

hook.text: Your friend says nothing's wrong but you sense sadness. You ask, and she cries. You read her accurately.

buildup.text: William Ickes studies empathic accuracy—how well people infer the specific content of another's thoughts and feelings.

discovery.text: Close partners average about 35% accuracy—far from perfect. Strangers score around 20%. Nobody is a true mind reader.

twist.text: Motivation matters more than ability. When people are incentivized to be accurate, their scores jump significantly.

climax.text: Empathic accuracy is a skill: asking good questions, listening actively, and checking your assumptions improve it.

punchline.text: You don't read minds. You read people who feel safe enough to show you.

quiz.question: What is the average empathic accuracy of close partners?
